title: 第9章 修仙从填饱肚子开始第10章 任务系统启动
lines: 姜望哪能看不出三人眼神里的那点小心思，觉得是时候给他们降降温了。
“本座虽身负太初道体，更有界灵引秘法召唤尔等前来，看似占尽先机，但我那些竞争对手，也绝非易与之辈。”
“像是瑶光仙子、百战真君、无名公子，他们的体质，比我只强不弱！”
“包括其余九十九人中的任何一个，所拥有的底牌或背后势力可能给予的隐秘支持，都不会简单。”
“他们降临下界，或许早已凭借自身手段或家族遗泽，迅速站稳脚跟，甚至开始网罗此界高手，构建势力。”
听到姜望坦言自己的那些竞争对手们个个不凡。
三人心中皆是一凛，直呼这都是一群什么“挂逼”
但马屁功夫还是立刻跟上。
“门主放心！”
莽穿地球立刻拍着胸脯保证道：“管他什么仙子真君，敢挡门主的路，等咱们兄弟发育起来，统统给他们剁了，圣子之位，非您莫属！”
“没错，我们定当竭尽全力，辅佐门主！”
琉璃仙梦同样连忙表态。
剑斩红尘也顺着话头说道：
“门主天赋异禀，又有我们……呃，这些天外助力，未来必能横扫太初。”
姜望不置可否地笑了笑，这些空头支票他自然不会当真。
但拍完马屁，核心问题便又回来了，莽穿地球搓着手，眼巴巴地问：
“门主，那……咱们什么时候可以开始修仙啊？您看，是不是先传我们一套入门功法？”
琉璃仙梦和剑斩红尘也立刻投来渴望的目光。
姜望心中暗叹，面上却依旧平静，甚至带着一丝高深莫测：
“修仙之道，首重根基，功法传承，绝非儿戏，况且，尔等可知，修仙第一步为何？”
三人面面相觑，莽穿地球试探道：“是……引气入体？”
“是测灵根。”
姜望淡淡说道：“灵根乃沟通天地灵气之桥梁，资质属性，皆源于此，若无对应法器探测，盲目修炼，轻则事倍功半，重则灵气冲突，爆体而亡。”
他指了指四周的荒山野岭：“此地乃苍梧州边陲，凡俗之地，莫说修仙功法，便是最基础的测灵石，也难寻一块。”
三人顿时像被泼了一盆冷水。
功法没有就算了。
连灵根都不知道是啥，这仙还怎么修？
姜望话锋一转，开始画饼：
“无需气馁，本座自会尽快设法为你们寻来测灵之物与合适功法，眼下，你们安心建设仙门，熟悉此界，亦是修行。”
话都说到这份上了，三人虽然失望，也只能接受。
剑斩红尘甚至自我安慰道：
“也许游戏官方就是想让我们先体验凡人阶段的不易，后面获得修仙能力后才更有成就感吧？说不定V0.1版本压根就没实装修仙功能呢……”
“好了，莫要空想。”
姜望将他们的注意力拉回现实，指了指地上的凶虎尸体：
“眼下，先将这畜生的尸体处理妥当，皮毛可制衣御寒，筋骨可尝试制作简陋武器，血肉乃是上佳食粮，不可浪费。”
处理大型动物尸体，对于三个现代人来说，无疑又是一项艰巨的挑战。
光是放血、剥皮、分解内脏，就让他们手忙脚乱，腥气扑鼻，视觉冲击力极强。
琉璃仙梦几次差点吐出来，强忍着不适才完成。
过程中，他们对这个世界的“真实”
有了更深刻，也更粗粝的体会。
当一整张相对完整的虎皮被剥下，大块大块鲜红的虎肉被分离出来时，三人竟也生出一种奇异的成就感。
在姜望的指挥下，他们又垒起简易的灶台，用收集来的干柴生火，开始烤肉。
“门主，这……这猛兽的肉，真的能吃吗？不会有毒或者太燥吧？”
content_en:
How could Jiang Wang not see the little thoughts in the eyes of the three people, and felt that it was time to cool them down.
"Although I have the Taoist body of Taichu, and I have world spirits to summon you with mystical techniques, I seem to have the upper hand, but my competitors are by no means easy to deal with."
"Like Fairy Yaoguang, True Lord Bai Zhan, and Young Master Wuming, their physiques are only stronger than mine!"
"Including any of the remaining ninety-nine people, the trump card they have or the secret support that the forces behind them may give will not be simple."
"When they came to the lower realm, they may have quickly established a foothold by relying on their own methods or family legacy, and even began to recruit experts in this realm to build their power."
I heard Jiang Wang admit that all of his competitors were extraordinary.
The three of them were all shocked, saying that these are all a bunch of "fools"
But the flattering effort followed immediately.
"Don't worry, Master!"
Mang Chuo Earth immediately patted his chest and promised: "Who cares about the Fairy True Lord, if he dares to block the way of the sect master, when our brothers grow up, they will all be chopped up by them. The position of the Holy Son belongs to you!"
"That's right, we will do our best to assist the sect master!"
Liuli Xianmeng also expressed his stance quickly.
Jian Zhan Hongchen also followed the words and said:
"The sect leader is extremely talented, and with our...well, these extraterrestrial help, he will definitely be able to sweep Taichu in the future."
Jiang Wang smiled noncommittally. Naturally, he would not take these empty promises seriously.
But after flattering him, the core question came back again. He rubbed his hands and asked eagerly:
"Master, then...when can we start cultivating immortals? Do you think you should teach us a set of introductory skills first?"
Liuli Xianmeng and Jianzhan Hongchen also immediately cast longing glances.
Jiang Wang sighed secretly in his heart, but his face remained calm, even with a hint of unpredictability:
"The way to cultivate immortality is based on the foundation and the inheritance of skills. It is by no means a child's play. Besides, you know, what is the first step in cultivating immortality?"
The three of them looked at each other in disbelief, and looked at the earth to test: "Is it... to introduce Qi into the body?"
"It's a spiritual root test."
Jiang Wang said calmly: "Spiritual roots are the bridge that connects the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. All qualifications and attributes are derived from this. If there is no corresponding magic weapon to detect and practice blindly, you will get twice the result with half the effort at best, or the spiritual energy will conflict and you will explode and die."
He pointed at the surrounding barren mountains and wild ridges: "This place is on the border of Cangwu State, a commonplace place. Not to mention the cultivation of immortality techniques, even the most basic spiritual stone is difficult to find."
The three of them suddenly felt as if they had been poured cold water on them.
Forget it if you don’t have the skills.
If you don't even know what spiritual roots are, how can this immortal cultivate?
Jiang Wang changed the subject and began to draw the cake:
"There is no need to be discouraged. I will try to find spirit-detecting objects and suitable techniques for you as soon as possible. For now, you can rest assured to build the immortal gate and become familiar with this world, which is also practice."
Now that it's all said and done, although the three of them are disappointed, they can only accept it.
Jian Zhan Hongchen even consoled himself:
"Perhaps the game official just wants us to experience the difficulty of the mortal stage first, and then we will have a greater sense of accomplishment after gaining the ability to cultivate immortals, right? Maybe the V0.1 version does not have the function of cultivating immortals at all..."
"Okay, don't have any daydreams."
Jiang Wang brought their attention back to reality and pointed at the corpse of the vicious tiger on the ground:
"Right now, let's dispose of the beast's body properly. The fur can be used to make clothes to keep out the cold, and the bones can be used to make crude weapons. The flesh and blood is the best food and should not be wasted."
Disposal of large animal carcasses is undoubtedly another difficult challenge for three modern humans.
Just bleeding, skinning, and decomposing internal organs left them in a hurry, the fishy smell hit their nostrils, and the visual impact was extremely strong.
Liuli Xianmeng almost vomited out several times, but endured the discomfort before finishing.
In the process, they learn about the "reality" of the world
I have a deeper and rougher experience.
When a relatively complete tiger skin was peeled off and large pieces of bright red tiger meat were separated, the three of them felt a strange sense of accomplishment.
Under Jiang Wang's command, they set up a simple stove, used the collected dry wood to light a fire, and began to barbecue.
"Master, is this...the meat of this beast really edible? Isn't it poisonous or too dry?"
title_en: Chapter 9: Cultivation of immortality begins with filling your stomach Chapter 10: The mission system starts
